text_to_image_prompt:
Create ONE single full-body image. 2:3 portrait canvas, head-to-toe uncut, complete hair and shoes, 6% margin top and bottom. Strict straight-on FRONT view, head upright face symmetrical, shoulders and hips level, relaxed arms at sides hands visible, feet slightly apart on same baseline. Long lens neutral undistorted straight camera, no perspective foreshortening. Character-specific body: 190 cm, broad athletic shoulders and solid chest, lean long legs. Approximately 8.0 to 8.2 anatomical heads tall from skull crown (exclude tall hair, crown, ears and hat) to soles. Long elegant legs and arms, natural normal neck, proportionate head; do not fake height with heels, tiny shrunken head, stretched neck or camera distortion. Different characters retain distinctive builds. Full outfit: Black slim straight denim, black leather motorcycle ankle boots, same black leather biker jacket and ribbed turtleneck.
Premium semi-realistic dimensional 3D character CG: finely sculpted face, delicate luminous skin microtexture, soft subsurface scattering, crisp eyes, individual wispy hair strands, detailed fabric and metal. Pure opaque white seamless studio background, bright soft neutral frontal light with balanced fill, subtle contact shadow. No text, labels, watermark, frame or collage borders. Preserve original age, facial anatomy, ethnicity, hair, eyes and accessories.
Character design: Male age 30. Midnight-black short brushed-back hair with wavy lifted quiff and one curved forelock, muted amethyst eyes. Wide rectangular face, pronounced cheek planes, deep-set narrow eyes, gently crooked prominent nose bridge, thin wide mouth, firm rounded chin. Neutral light beige skin. Black leather biker jacket with subtle silver zips over black ribbed turtleneck. Controlled confident gaze.
reproduction_note: 此为带身份参考图生成的补充素材；独立文字提示词已重建，未经纯文生图复现验证。严格同脸请同时使用身份母版。
